secondaryMissions.description: **WHEN DRAWN:** If there are no enemy units with a **starting strength** of 13+ on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new **Secondary Mission** card.

scoring.scoringCriteria: For each enemy unit with a **starting strength** of 13+ **destroyed** this turn.
For each enemy unit with a **starting strength** of 13+ **destroyed** this turn.

secondaryMissions.name: No Prisoners
secondaryMissions.lore: Show no mercy. Exterminate your enemies.

scoring.scoringCriteria: For each enemy unit **destroyed** this turn.

secondaryMissions.name: Overwhelming Force
secondaryMissions.lore: The enemy holds your assigned objectives. Commit your forces in full and sweep them from these locations post‑haste.

scoring.scoringCriteria: For each enemy unit that started the turn within range of one or more **objectives** and is **destroyed**.

secondaryMissions.name: A Tempting Target
secondaryMissions.lore: An opportunity to seize a valuable asset has been identified, but the enemy are likely to use it as bait in a trap. Move to secure the site, but be wary of enemy ambushes.
secondaryMissions.description: **WHEN DRAWN:** Your opponent selects one **objective** (excluding **home objectives**) within No Man’s Land to be your **tempting target**.

scoring.scoringCriteria: You control your **tempting target**.

secondaryMissions.name: Behind Enemy Lines
secondaryMissions.lore: Your orders are clear: break through the enemy and cut off their escape routes.
secondaryMissions.description: **WHEN DRAWN:** If it is the first battle round, you can draw one new **Secondary Mission** card and shuffle this card back into your **Secondary** **Mission** deck.

scoring.scoringCriteria: For each friendly unit (excluding **AIRCRAFT** and **battle‑shocked** units) wholly within your opponent’s deployment zone.

secondaryMissions.name: Defend Stronghold
secondaryMissions.lore: You are charged with the defence of a critical objective. It must not be permitted to fall into enemy hands.
secondaryMissions.description: **WHEN DRAWN:** If it is the first battle round, draw one new **Secondary Mission** card and shuffle this card back into your **Secondary Mission** deck.

objectives.name: SECOND BATTLE ROUND ONWARDS
objectives.whenText: End of your opponent’s turn or the end of the fifth battle round (whichever comes first).

scoring.scoringCriteria: You control your **home objective**.
No enemy units are within your deployment zone.

missionTwists.name: Mirrored World
missionTwists.lore: As destinies converge, rival warlords find themselves on parallel paths, competing with one another to achieve near‑identical outcomes and objectives.
missionTwists.rules:
The players both replace their **Primary Mission** card with the same one of the following **Primary Mission** cards. If both players agree on one of them, use that **Primary Mission** card; otherwise, roll a D6 and consult the table below.

**PRIMARY MISSION**
Mission - D6
Battlefield Dominance - 1
Meatgrinder - 2
Outmanoeuvre - 3
Gather Intel - 4
Sabotage - 5
(Roll again) - 6

**Designer’s Note:** *This is a great twist for players who want to play a simpler battle of Warhammer 40,000, as both players will be trying to achieve the same* **Primary Mission**.

missionTwists.name: Ruinscape
missionTwists.lore: Decades of war have reduced the structures on this battlefield to hollow ruins. Your warriors stalk and scramble through the skeletal remnants of half‑destroyed buildings as they close in upon their enemies.
missionTwists.rules:
When a unit makes a **normal** or **advance move**, models in that unit have the **MOBILE** keyword until that move ends.

**Designer’s Note:** *For players who want to play with a lot of terrain and/or with many large models, this twist can help keep the battle flowing.*

missionTwists.name: Scrambled Communications
missionTwists.lore: Scrambled communications and intertwined vox‑channels have disrupted the chain of command, leaving your orders and objectives unclear.
missionTwists.rules:
The players exchange their **Primary Mission** cards.

**Designer’s Note:** *This is a great twist to shake things up in a regular match-up, or for players who love to embrace chaos!*

missionTwists.name: Night Fighting
missionTwists.lore: A shroud of darkness has fallen across the battlefield, obscuring the vision of your warriors and providing them with cover beneath which to advance.
missionTwists.rules:
Each unit is not **visible** to enemy models unless they are within 18" of that unit, and each unit cannot be targeted by **[INDIRECT FIRE]** weapons unless the attacking model is within 18" of that unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *This is a great twist for players who do not yet have a battlefield’s worth of terrain.*

missionTwists.name: Martial Pride
missionTwists.lore: The rank and file of your armies are determined to demonstrate their value, advancing relentlessly toward their assigned objectives whilst maintaining a punishing rate of fire.
missionTwists.rules:
A **BATTLELINE** unit can **start an action** in a turn in which it made an **advance move**.
A **BATTLELINE** unit can **shoot in a turn** in which it **started an action**.

**Designer’s Note:** *This is a great twist for Incursion battles.*

missionTwists.name: Nowhere to Hide
missionTwists.lore: This battlefield only affords the illusion of cover – nowhere is safe.
missionTwists.rules:
**Terrain features** do not have the **Solid** rule.

**Designer’s Note:** *This twist lets models draw **line of sight** through any gap in a **terrain feature**, allowing more ‘true line of sight’ and more lethal shooting.*
